products.name: Zeemo
products.note: Video captioning AI; translation; subtitle styling; content accessibility

profile_text.body:
Zeemo is a web-based creative platform that describes itself as an all-in-one AI studio for image, video, and caption work. According to its own site, it allows users to generate images, video, audio, captions, and music within a single tool, and it positions itself toward content creators, educational institutions, and media companies.

The platform's core AI product, also called Zeemo, sits in the video generation and editing category. Its documented features include video captioning, transcription of video and audio to text, subtitle styling, video translation, and caption extraction. The site also lists more specialized generation tools such as an AI cartoon video generator, an AI pixel video generator, and a dark fantasy AI video generator, as well as an AI reel maker.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
